body:
Lemon Balm on its own is relaxing and anxiety relieving, even though it is quite mild. I still love the lemony taste and smell plus the general feel of of this herb. The smoke is smooth for the most part, and is pleasant to smoke.
As others have alluded to, Lemon balm is most certainly psychoactive. But in my opinion it serves its job much better with the combination of other herbs, most prominently Cannabis. This elevates the high of both herbs. And Lemon Balm makes for an amazing and much less harmful alternative to Tobacco for when I need to mix Cannabis with something. Hash burns great with Lemon Balm as well.
